answer_1.quote: For image caption generation, recent reference-based metrics have sought to transcend overlap by considering richer models of reference-candidate similarity...
models: systems from MSCOCO Image Captioning Challenge

answer_2.quote: We show that a relatively direct application of CLIP to (image, generated caption) pairs results in surprisingly high correlation with human judgments...

answer_4.quote: Flickr8K-Expert contains 17K 'expert' human judgments between 5664 images: humans graded captions on a scale of 1 to 4 (4='caption describes the image without any errors'; 1='caption is unrelated to the image').
answer_4.guideline: Grade captions on a scale of 1 to 4 based on correctness of description.
